gumtree_entries.description: ADDED i1: Tests {@link StringTokenizer#reset(char[])}, which re-points an existing tokenizer at a new character-array input and clears any prior parsing state.
ADDED i2: Start with some unrelated input so we can prove reset() replaces it.
ADDED i3: reset(char[]) should discard the old input and tokenize the new one. The default tokenizer treats whitespace as a delimiter, so "abc" (no whitespace) is parsed
ADDED i4: Resetting with a null array yields a tokenizer with no tokens.
